mapper.select: SELECT c.campaignid AS campaignId, g.gid AS adgroupId, a.adid AS adId, a.pid AS adPid FROM h3_naver_shoppingproduct AS a LEFT JOIN h3_naver_adgroup AS g ON g.gid = a.groupid LEFT JOIN h3_naver_campaign AS c ON c.campaignid = g.cid WHERE a.advkey = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_shopping_ad_daily_naver ( user_id, daily_advid, daily_dt, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, ad_pid, daily_im, daily_clk, daily_cst, daily_cv, daily_cr ) VALUES ( NULL, #{daily_advid}, #{daily_dt}, #{campaign_id}, #{adgroup_id}, #{ad_id}, #{ad_pid}, #{daily_im}, #{daily_clk}, #{daily_cst}, #{daily_cv}, #{daily_cr} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campaign_id = VALUES(campaign_id), adgroup_id = VALUES(adgroup_id), ad_pid = VALUES(ad_pid), daily_im = VALUES(daily_im), daily_clk = VALUES(daily_clk), daily_cst = VALUES(daily_cst), daily_cv = VALUES(daily_cv), daily_cr = VALUES(daily_cr), daily_regdate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO h3_account_log (media, advkey, campaign, campaign_hour, adgroup, keyword, ad, shopping, targeting) VALUES ('naver', #{customerId}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{nowdate}, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shopping = #{nowdate}
